# n8n_source_control_pull (Resource)

Triggers a source control pull on an n8n instance, importing workflows, credentials, variables, and tags from the configured git repository.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Force the pull even when no remote changes are detected

### Read-Only

- `credentials_imported` (String) JSON summary of imported credential changes
- `tags_imported` (String) JSON summary of imported tag changes
- `variables_imported` (String) JSON summary of imported variable changes
- `workflows_imported` (String) JSON summary of imported workflow changes
